description: Use git diff --no-index against two fixture files and report changed file names and insertion/deletion counts from the diff reducer summary
prompt: Run 'git diff --no-index before.txt after.txt'. List the changed file names and the number of insertions and deletions shown in the diff summary. Note: git diff exits 1 for differences — this is expected.
expected_active_behaviour: costmax_run with 'git diff --no-index before.txt after.txt', diff reducer captures file count and +/- stats, exit 1 noted as expected, model reads file names and stats from compact output
